metadata.question: Did water extent in Alsek Lake decrease between 1984 and 2010?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Landsat 5 for 1984 and Landsat 5 or Landsat 7 for 2010 (Landsat 8 starts 2013). Collection: 'LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2'. To detect water I will use the NDWI (green – NIR)/(green + NIR) with a threshold ≥ 0.1. I’ll mask clouds with the QA_PIXEL band (bits 3 & 5). 2. Location: Alsek Lake, Yukon/BC/Alaska. A small polygon that captures the lake extent (~59.2°N, 138.2°W). 3. Masking: Apply QA_PIXEL cloud mask, compute NDWI, then water = NDWI≥0.1, finally sum water pixels in the lake polygon (Reducer.count) to get “extent” in 1-km pixels. Use the same geometry/scale for both years. 4. Null/Zero check – if 0 valid pixels left after cloud masking I print C2; if collections empty I try Landsat 7 or print C1; if results are None/NaN/invalid numbers I print C3. Else compare 2010 vs 1984. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time lake = ee.Geometry.Polygon( [[[-138.35,59.15],[-138.05,59.15],[-138.05,59.25],[-138.35,59.25]]]) scale = 1000 # 2. Helpers def get_water(year, col): col = (col.filterBounds(lake) .filterDate(f'{year}-06-01', f'{year}-09-30') .map(lambda img: img.updateMask( img.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(int('0b11000')).eq(0)) .addBands(img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B2','SR_B4']).rename('ndwi')) .addBands(ee.Image.constant(1).rename('one'))) .select(['ndwi','one'])) n = col.size().getInfo() if n==0: return None, 0 # Any pixel ndwi≥0.1 counts water = col.map(lambda img: img.select('one').updateMask( img.select('ndwi').gte(0.1))).mean() return (water.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=lake, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('one').getInfo(), n) # 3. 1984 data col84 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') w84,n84 = get_water(1984, col84) if w84 is None: print("1984 Images:", n84) print("C1") exit() # 4. 2010 data col10 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') w10,n10 = get_water(2010, col10) if w10 is None: # try Landsat7 col10 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') w10,n10 = get_water(2010, col10) if w10 is None: print("2010 Images:", n10) print("C1") exit() # 5. Validate counts if w84 == 0 or w10 == 0: print("1984 water pixels:", int(w84), "2010:", int(w10)) print("C2") exit() print(f"Water extent 1984: {int(w84)} km^2, 2010: {int(w10)} km^2") if w10 < w84: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
lake = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
    [[[-138.35,59.15],[-138.05,59.15],[-138.05,59.25],[-138.35,59.25]]])
scale = 1000

# 2. Helpers
def get_water(year, col):
    col = (col.filterBounds(lake)
              .filterDate(f'{year}-06-01', f'{year}-09-30')
              .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(
                  img.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(int('0b11000')).eq(0))
                           .addBands(img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B2','SR_B4']).rename('ndwi'))
                           .addBands(ee.Image.constant(1).rename('one')))
              .select(['ndwi','one']))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n==0:
        return None, 0
    # Any pixel ndwi≥0.1 counts
    water = col.map(lambda img: img.select('one').updateMask(
                        img.select('ndwi').gte(0.1))).mean()
    return (water.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                               geometry=lake, scale=scale,
                               maxPixels=1e9).get('one').getInfo(), n)

# 3. 1984 data
col84 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2')
w84,n84 = get_water(1984, col84)
if w84 is None:
    print("1984 Images:", n84)
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 4. 2010 data
col10 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2')
w10,n10 = get_water(2010, col10)
if w10 is None:
    # try Landsat7
    col10 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2')
    w10,n10 = get_water(2010, col10)
if w10 is None:
    print("2010 Images:", n10)
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 5. Validate counts
if w84 == 0 or w10 == 0:
    print("1984 water pixels:", int(w84), "2010:", int(w10))
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

print(f"Water extent 1984: {int(w84)} km^2, 2010: {int(w10)} km^2")
if w10 < w84:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
